motivation: Examine the instantaneous-speed assumption in the nominal stop-and-turn proxy before introducing finite acceleration.

oneDimensionalProfile.speedShape: linear increase across the whole interval

studentTask: A schematic robot starts at rest and increases speed evenly from0 to1virtualcell/s over1second. How many virtual cells does it travel during that second?
formulaHint: For this linear-speed ramp only: averageSpeed=(initialSpeed+finalSpeed)/2; distance=averageSpeed*duration.
scope: Pending guided one-dimensional kinematic hand calculation, not measured motor acceleration, a completed acceleration/timed-trajectory implementation, controller, collision or physical test. Existing constant-rate proxy and its archived results remain unchanged.
